title: 5.3.1 Spatiotemporal Distribution of Temperature 🌡️
content:
ሰላም ለናንተ ይሁን🙋‍♀️🙋‍♂️! የቃሉ ባለቤት☝️☝️☝️። ይህ ከባለፈው ማለትም ከፓርት 1 የቀጠለ ነው። በቆይታችን የመጠነ-ሙቀት ስርጭት ከቦታ እና ከጊዜ አንፃር አንመለከታለን👇👇👇።

**Key Drivers of Temperature in Ethiopia:**
* Altitude is the most important element determining temperature.
* Latitude, humidity, and winds also have significant impacts.
* Because Ethiopia is near the equator, it experiences the overhead sun twice a year.

**Amharic Explanation:**
በኢትዮጵያ የሙቀት መጠን (Temperature) ላይ ትልቁን ተፅዕኖ የሚያሳድረው ከፍታ (Altitude) ነው። ኢትዮጵያ ለምድር ወገብ (Equator) ቅርብ ብትሆንም፣ ከፍተኛ ቦታ (Highland) ስለሆነች ሙሉ በሙሉ ሞቃታማ (Tropical) አየር ንብረት ላትም። አየሩ ወደ መሃል አገር (ከፍተኛ ቦታዎች) ስንሄድ እየቀዘቀዘ ይመጣል።

**Temperature Extremes:**
* The highest temperature extremes are recorded in the Afar Depression, where the mean maximum exceeds 30°C.
* The lowest temperature extremes are found in the Bale Mountains.

**Amharic Explanation:**
በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ከፍተኛው የሙቀት መጠን የሚመዘገበው በአፋር ዲፕሬሽን (ከ 30° ሴንቲግሬድ በላይ) ሲሆን፣ ዝቅተኛው ደግሞ በባሌ ተራሮች ላይ ይገኛል።

💡 **Exam Hint:** Remember that Ethiopia's daily temperature range is high (big difference between day and night), but the annual range is small (minimal variation between monthly averages)!

**Amharic Explanation:**
ለፈተና ማስታወሻ፦ የኢትዮጵያ የዕለት ተዕለት የሙቀት መጠን ልዩነት (Daily temperature range) ሰፊ ሲሆን፣ የዓመታዊ የሙቀት መጠን ልዩነት ግን አነስተኛ መሆኑን አትርሱ!

title: 🏔️ Traditional Temperature Zones of Ethiopia
content:
**Table of Temperature Zones vs. Altitude**

| Altitude (meter) | Mean Annual Temp (°C) | Description | Local Equivalent |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3,300 and above | 10 or less | Cool | **Wurch** |
| 2,300 - 3,300 | 10 – 15 | Cool Temperate | **Dega** |
| 1,500 - 2,300 | 15 – 20 | Temperate | **Woina Dega** |
| 500 - 1,500 | 20 – 25 | Warm Temperate | **Kola** |
| below 500 | 25 and above | Hot | **Bereha** |

**Amharic Note:**
ይህ ሠንጠረዥ ለፈተና እጅግ በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው! እያንዳንዱን ዞን ከከፍታው እና ከሙቀት መጠኑ ጋር አያይዛችሁ አጥኑ። ለምሳሌ፡- ወይና ደጋ (Woina Dega) ከ1500 እስከ 2300 ሜትር ከፍታ እና ከ15-20°C ሙቀት አለው። ትኩረት ስጡት እሽ ይሄን አካባቢ Matching ይወዱታል።ቴብሉ ግልፅ ካልሆነላችሁ ከሞጅላችሁ ላይ page 57 Table 5.1 ላይ ታገኙታላችሁ.

title: 5.3.2 Spatiotemporal Distribution of Rainfall 🌧️
content:
**The ITCZ (Inter Tropical Convergence Zone):**
* Rainfall in Ethiopia is highly variable and primarily influenced by the position of the ITCZ.
* The ITCZ is a low-pressure zone formed by the convergence of Northeast Trade winds and Equatorial Westerlies.
* As the ITCZ shifts north and south following the overhead sun, equatorial westerlies bring moist winds to Ethiopia.

**Amharic Explanation:**
ITCZ ማለት የሰሜን እና የደቡብ ንፋሶች የሚገናኙበት ዝቅተኛ የግፊት ቀጠና (Low-pressure zone) ነው። ይህ ቀጠና ፀሀይን ተከትሎ ወደ ሰሜን እና ደቡብ ይንቀሳቀሳል። ITCZ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ሲመጣ እርጥበት አዘል ንፋሶችን ይዞ ስለሚመጣ ዝናብ ይጥላል። am I clear?

💡 **Exam Hint:** The shift of the trade winds from the north retreating in July gives space for equatorial westerlies, causing the main rainy season.

title: 🌍 Seasons in Ethiopia vs. International (Crucial Concept!)
content:
**Understanding the Seasonal Differences:**
In this module, seasons are defined by Northern Hemisphere months, which can be confusing compared to Ethiopian local seasons.

**Amharic Explanation (ወቅቶች):**
በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እና በኢትዮጵያ ሞጁል አውድ ወቅቶች የሚገለጹት እንደሚከተለው ነው፡-
* Summer covers June, July, and August, which is considered the warm season in Europe and America, but in Ethiopia, it is **ክረምት** (the main rainy season).
* Autumn covers September, October, and November, which is locally referred to as **ፀደይ**.
* Winter covers December, January, and February, which is an international cold and snowy period, but in Ethiopia, it is **በጋ** (the dry season).
* Spring covers March, April, and May, which corresponds to the Ethiopian **በልግ** (minor rainy season).

ይህንን የቃላት አጠቃቀም ልዩነት (Summer = ክረምት, Winter = በጋ) ለፈተና ለይታችሁ ማወቅ አለባችሁ! በነገራችን ላይ ይሄን የምችሁ ሀሳቡ ካሁን በፊት ከምታውቁት የኢትዮጵያ የወቅቶች ስያሜ ጋር እንዳይጋጭባችሁ ነው እንጂ ፈተና የምትሠሩት በኢንተርናሽናሉ ሰያሜ ሁኖ Based on Ethiopian Geograpy ነው። ለምሳሌ ሞጅላችሁ Winter ሲል ክረምት ማለቱ ነው ነገር ግን ራሱ ቃሉን ከኢትዮጵያ አጠራር እና መልክዓምድራዊ መገኛ አንፃር በጋ እንለዋለን። ተጨማሪ ማብራሪያ: ሁለት ንፍቀ-ክበብ እንዳለ ታውቃላችሁ? ከላይ ቀደም ብለን እንዳዬነው በአንደኛው ንፍቀ-ክበብ ቀን ሲሆን በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በሌለኛው ሌሊት ይሆናል ብለናል አሁንም ልላችሁ የፈለኩት በተመሳሳይ ወቅት በአንደኛው ንፍቀ-ክበብ ክረምት ሲሆን በሌለኛው በጋ ይሆናል።ለዚህ ነው በኢትዮጵያና በኢንተርናሽናሉ መካከል የአጠራር ልዩነት የተፈጠረው። አሁን ግልፅ ይመስለኛል ወይስ ግራ አጋባኃችሁ? በቃ ቀለል አድርጋችሁ አዩትና ወደ ቀጣዩ እንሻገር 👇👇👇。

title: 🌧️ Seasonal Rainfall Variabilities (The Winds)
content:
**1. Summer (June, July, August):**
* Receives main rainfall from Equatorial Westerlies (Guinea monsoon) and Easterlies.
* Covers most regions except Afar and Southeast lowlands.

**Amharic Explanation:**
በክረምት ወቅት (ሰኔ፣ ሐምሌ እና ነሐሴ) አብዛኛው የሀገሪቱ ክፍል ዋናውን ዝናብ ከኢኳቶሪያል ቨስተርሊስ (የጊኒ ሞንሱን) እና ከኢስተርሊስ ንፋሶች ያገኛል።

**2. Autumn (September, October, November):**
* The Southeasterlies from the Indian Ocean provide showers to the Southeastern lowlands of Ethiopia.

**AmharicExplanation:**
በመፀው ወራት (መስከረም፣ ጥቅምት እና ህዳር) ከህንድ ውቅያኖስ የሚነሱ የደቡብ ምስራቅ ንፋሶች (Southeasterlies) ለደቡብ ምስራቅ ዝቅተኛ ቦታዎች ዝናብ ይሰጣሉ።

**3. Winter (December, January, February):**
* Dominated by Northeasterly winds from Asia/Red Sea.
* Supplies rain only to Afar lowlands and Red Sea coastal areas.

**Amharic Explanation:**
በበጋ ወቅት (ታህሳስ፣ ጥር እና የካቲት) ከእስያ እና ከቀይ ባህር በሚነሱ የሰሜን ምስራቅ ንፋሶች (Northeasterlies) የሚመራ ሲሆን ዝናብ የሚሰጠው ለአፋር ዝቅተኛ ቦታዎች እና ለቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢዎች ብቻ ነው።

**4. Spring (March, April, May):**
* Southeasterlies from the Indian Ocean provide rain to central and southeastern highlands/lowlands.

**Amharic Explanation:**
በበልግ ወቅት (መጋቢት፣ ሚያዝያ እና ግንቦት) ከህንድ ውቅያኖስ የሚመጡ ንፋሶች ለመካከለኛው እና ለደቡብ ምስራቅ አከባቢዎች ዝናብ ያስገኛሉ።

💡 **Exam Hint:** Match the season with the wind! (Summer = Equatorial Westerlies, Winter = Northeasterly).

title: 🗺️ Rainfall Regions of Ethiopia
content:
**1. Summer Rainfall Region:**
* Comprises almost all parts except SE and NE lowlands.
* Wet summer corresponds to areas receiving more than 1,000 mm of rainfall, typical of high altitudes and windward sides.

**2. All Year-Round Rainfall Region:**
* Covers the southwestern part of Ethiopia.
* Experiences the most rainy days due to moist Guinea Monsoons, with average annual rainfall ranging from 1,400 to over 2,200 mm.

**3. Autumn and Spring Rainfall Regions:**
* Encompasses the southeastern lowlands receiving rain from southeasterly winds originating from the Indian Ocean.

**4. Winter Rainfall Region:**
* Includes the Red Sea escarpments and the Afar region, which receive their main rain from northeasterly winds.

**Amharic Note:**
ዓመቱን ሙሉ ዝናብ የሚያገኘው የደቡብ ምዕራብ (Southwestern) የሀገሪቱ ክፍል መሆኑን አትዘንጉ!

title: 5.4 Agro-ecological Zones of Ethiopia 🌾 (Part 1)
content:
**1. The Wurch Zone (Cold to Moist):**
* Altitude is above 3,200 meters.
* Temperature is below 10°C.
* Examples include Ras Dashen, Guna, Megezez, Batu, and Choke.
* **Amharic:** በጣም ከፍተኛ እና ቀዝቃዛ ተራራማ ቦታዎች።

**2. Dega Zone (Cool to Humid):**
* Altitude ranges from 2,300 to 3,200 meters.
* Temperature ranges from 11.5 to 17.5°C.
* Key Fact: Densely populated due to reliable rainfall for agriculture and the absence of vector-borne diseases like malaria.
* **Amharic:** ለኑሮ ተስማሚ እና የወባ በሽታ የማይገኝበት በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ሰፈራ ያለበት ዞን ነው።

💡 **Exam Hint:** Why is Dega densely populated? Answer: Reliable rain & No malaria!

title: 5.4 Agro-ecological Zones of Ethiopia 🌵 (Part 2)
content:
**3. Weyna Dega Zone (Cool Sub-humid):**
* Altitude ranges from 1,500 to 2,300 meters.
* Key Fact: It is the second largest zone accounting for 26.75%, includes most of the agricultural land, is suitable for the majority of crops, and has two growing seasons.

**Amharic Explanation:**
ወይና ደጋ ዞን ሁለተኛው ትልቅ ቦታ ሲሆን (26.75%)፣ አብዛኛውን የእርሻ መሬት ይይዛል፣ ለብዙ አትክልትና ሰብሎች ተስማሚ ነው፣ እንዲሁም በሁለት የእርሻ ወቅቶች ይታወቃል።

**4. Kolla Zone (Warm Semi-arid):**
* Altitude ranges from 500 to 1,500 meters.
* Key Fact: Serves as a boundary between hot arid and humid climates, with Gambella (wet western lowland) getting up to 1,500 mm of rain.

**Amharic Explanation:**
ቆላ ዞን ከፍታው ከ500 እስከ 1500 ሜትር ሲሆን፣ በሞቃታማ በረሃማና እርጥበታማ አየር ንብረት መካከል ያለ ድንበር ነው። ጋምቤላ እስከ 1500 ሚሜ ዝናብ ማግኘት ትችላለች።

**5. Bereha Zone (Hot Arid):**
* Altitude is below 500 meters and drops below sea level around Danakil.
* Temperature is over 27.5°C with an average annual rainfall of less than 200 mm.
* **Amharic:** በጣም ሞቃታማ እና በረሃማ (Desert) አካባቢዎች። ትነት (Evapotranspiration) ከዝናብ መጠን ይበልጣል。 Agro-ecological Zones of Ethiopia የሚለውን ቶፒክ የሚያጠቃልል Summery Table ከሞጅላችሁ page 62 Table 5.2 ላይ እንድታዩት መልዕክቴ ነው ፈተና ላይ አይቀርም።

 ለዛሬ በዚህ እናበቃለን። በቀጣይ ፓርት 3ን በማየት ቻፕተሩን እናጠናቅቃለን።በቀጣይ እስክንገናኝ በደህና ቆዩኝ!!!
